typed_comment_sweep._note: These are the OPERATOR's words, not the system's disposition. Every flagged comment observed still ends in a positive disposition -- e.g. 「…要注意。発注書確認・登録完了。」 is flagged AND completed. So the SYSTEM outcome remains constant while the OPERATOR's recorded judgement varies.

_finding: G4 REOPENS, NARROWLY AND PRECISELY. The SYSTEM disposition is still constant: 0 candidate negative outcomes in screen text, 0 backward transitions, 0 records reaching two terminal states, 0 screenshot filename hits -- all zero. But the OPERATOR's own annotation varies: 26 of 481 distinct typed comments (5.4%) carry an exception marker (差異あり/要注意/要確認), against their clean counterparts (差異なし 36, 通常 46). Every flagged record was still disposed positively. So there IS a supervision signal, but it is the operator's recorded judgement, not the system's outcome -- a different and much smaller target than the original hypothesis assumed.
_affordance_finding: The UI EXPOSES a rejection path. The comment box on the disposition screen is labelled 「承認コメントまたは差戻し理由を入力してください…」 -- 'enter an approval comment or a send-back reason' -- appearing on browser_click and browser_form_input events. So 差戻し (send-back) is a supported action that was never exercised in this capture window. This reframes G4: the dataset does not show that rejection never happens, it shows that this ~2-hour window contains none. The distinction matters for Step 3, because a system trained or evaluated here has never seen the branch the interface is built around.
